description: This file contains classes and functions for processing conversation transcripts, including user and assistant message handling, aggregation of speech/text frames, and event management within a speech/text processing pipeline.

classes.name: BaseTranscriptProcessor
classes.description: Base class providing common functionality for processing conversation transcripts, including message emission and event handling.

classes.name: UserTranscriptProcessor
classes.description: Processes user transcription frames into timestamped conversation messages.

classes.name: AssistantTranscriptProcessor
classes.description: Processes assistant TTS and LLM thought frames into timestamped messages, with aggregation of speech and thought fragments.

classes.name: TranscriptProcessor
classes.description: Factory class managing user and assistant transcript processors with shared event handling, supporting both TTS and LLM thought frames.

methods.name: BaseTranscriptProcessor.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the base processor with message store and registers event handler.

methods.name: BaseTranscriptProcessor._emit_update
methods.description: Emits transcript update frames with new messages.

methods.name: UserTranscriptProcessor.process_frame
methods.description: Processes transcription frames into user messages.

methods.name: AssistantTranscriptProcessor.__init__
methods.description: Initializes assistant processor with aggregation state for speech and thought fragments.

methods.name: AssistantTranscriptProcessor._emit_aggregated_assistant_text
methods.description: Aggregates and emits assistant speech fragments as a message.

methods.name: AssistantTranscriptProcessor._emit_aggregated_thought
methods.description: Aggregates and emits thought fragments as a message.

methods.name: AssistantTranscriptProcessor.process_frame
methods.description: Processes frames into assistant speech and thought messages, handling aggregation and state transitions.

methods.name: TranscriptProcessor.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the factory managing user and assistant processors with optional thought processing.

methods.name: TranscriptProcessor.user
methods.description: Returns the user transcript processor, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: TranscriptProcessor.assistant
methods.description: Returns the assistant transcript processor, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: TranscriptProcessor.event_handler
methods.description: Registers an event handler for both user and assistant processors.
